title: Bound on notable neighbor coordinates
statement: Let $G$ be a regular unique game with alphabet size $q$, and let $T$ assign a Boolean function on the $q$-dimensional sign cube to each vertex. If $0<\varepsilon\le 1$, then at any vertex the number of coordinates whose stable influence at parameter $1-\varepsilon$ in the average of its permutation-adjusted neighbors' functions is strictly greater than $\varepsilon$ is at most $1/\varepsilon^2$.
